Name: Four Corners - Maximized
Author: ActionJackson22
Description: Fighting for space? The four corners map is nice but the scenery (while beautiful) takes a lot away from what you can do on your farm. Enter this mod, it removes the cliffs and simplifies the layout a bit in a non-intrusive way to give you a little more breathing room on your farm. This mod should be a no-hassle replacement  for any or all of your four corners maps, new and existing.

Manifest.Name: FourCornersMaximized
Manifest.Description: Improved multiplayer map with a bit more space
